title.english: The Cup at the Cart Shed

pairs.target: tiān méi liàng tòu , tǎ wéi xiān ràng ménbiān de shuǐbēi bàn le yíxià .
pairs.english: Before dawn had fully broken, Tavi stumbled over the cup by the door.
pairs.hanzi: 天没亮透，塔维先让门边的水杯绊了一下。

pairs.target: bēizi méiyǒu dǎo . tā dūnxià bǎ tā ná qǐlái , xiǎngqǐ zhè shì zìjǐ zuóyè tèyì fàng de , yòu hǎoqì yòu hǎoxiào .
pairs.english: The cup did not fall. He crouched to pick it up, remembered he had deliberately put it there last night, and felt both annoyed and amused.
pairs.hanzi: 杯子没有倒。他蹲下把它拿起来，想起这是自己昨夜特意放的，又好气又好笑。

pairs.target: pà wò cóng bèizi lǐ wèn shuí zài chāifáng , tā shuō sòng rén , pà wò lìkè zuò qǐ , étóu zhuàng zài chuángyán shàng , mà dé bǐ gāngcái qīngxǐng .
pairs.english: From under his bedding, Pavo asked who was demolishing the room. Tavi said they were seeing someone off. Pavo sat up at once, struck his forehead on the bed frame, and swore more wakefully than before.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃从被子里问谁在拆房，他说送人，帕沃立刻坐起，额头撞在床沿上，骂得比刚才清醒。

pairs.target: tāmen dào chēpéng shí , mǐlā yǐjīng tì dé mǎ ànzhe bāo . bāo bǐ zuóyè pàng le yìquān , bǎngshéng zěnme yě dā búdào yìqǐ .
pairs.english: When they reached the cart shed, Mira was already holding Dema’s bag down. It had grown fatter overnight, and the binding cord would not meet.
pairs.hanzi: 他们到车棚时，米拉已经替德玛按着包。包比昨夜胖了一圈，绑绳怎么也搭不到一起。

pairs.target: yīwén zhàn zài pángbiān , shǒulǐ ná zhe yíjuàn zhǐ , bùtíng quàn tā bǎ sāi zài wàicè de dìèr shuāng xié ná chūlái . " shíèrtiān . " tā shuō , " búshì shíèrnián . "
pairs.english: Iven stood beside them with a paper roll, repeatedly urging her to remove the second pair of shoes wedged outside. “Twelve days,” he said. “Not twelve years.”
pairs.hanzi:
伊文站在旁边，手里拿着一卷纸，不停劝她把塞在外侧的第二双鞋拿出来。
“十二天。”他说，“不是十二年。”

pairs.target: " shī le huàn shénme ? huàn nǐ de zuǐ ? "
pairs.english: “What do I change into when they get wet? Your mouth?”
pairs.hanzi: “湿了换什么？换你的嘴？”

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī zǒu guòlái , méi guǎn tāmen chǎo , zhī wèn bēizi zài nǎér . tǎ wéi jǔ qǐlái , dé mǎ de yǎnjīng lìkè liàng le .
pairs.english: Instructor Jian came over, ignored their quarrel, and asked only where the cup was. Tavi raised it, and Dema’s eyes lit up at once.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师走过来，没管他们吵，只问杯子在哪儿。塔维举起来，德玛的眼睛立刻亮了。

pairs.target: tā jiēguò qù , wǎng bāo biān yí shì , gāngcái quē de nà yì jié shéng gèng duǎn le .
pairs.english: She took it and tried it beside the bag; the missing stretch of cord became shorter still.
pairs.hanzi: 她接过去，往包边一试，刚才缺的那一截绳更短了。

pairs.target: pà wò shuō zìjǐ lái . tā dūn dào bāo qián , jiāng xié zhuǎn le fāngxiàng , yòu bǎ juǎnqǐ de wàzi sāijìn xié tǒng .
pairs.english: Pavo said he would do it. Crouching before the bag, he turned the shoes around and stuffed rolled socks into their shafts.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃说自己来。他蹲到包前，将鞋转了方向，又把卷起的袜子塞进鞋筒。

pairs.target: shéngzi zhōngyú dā shàng , dé mǎ què shēnshǒu cóng lìngyìbiān chōuchū yígè xiǎo bùtóu . shì zhī fèng dé wāiwāiniǔniǔ de láng , zuǐ dà , ěrduo xiǎo , dùzǐ yòng jiù zhǐ sāi dé gǔgǔde .
pairs.english: The cord finally met, but Dema reached around the other side and pulled out a little cloth object: a crookedly sewn wolf with a big mouth, small ears and a belly stuffed plump with old paper.
pairs.hanzi:
绳子终于搭上，德玛却伸手从另一边抽出一个小布头。
是只缝得歪歪扭扭的狼，嘴大，耳朵小，肚子用旧纸塞得鼓鼓的。

pairs.target: " shuí fàng de ? " pà wò dītóu lāshéng , shuō cèzhàn yèlǐ ānjìng , pà tā chànggē méirénjiē .
pairs.english: “Who put this in?” Pavo looked down and pulled the cord, saying the station would be quiet at night and he feared nobody would answer her singing.
pairs.hanzi:
“谁放的？”
帕沃低头拉绳，说测站夜里安静，怕她唱歌没人接。

pairs.target: dé mǎ jiāng láng jǔ dào tā liǎn qián , tā de zuǐ gānghǎo néng yǎozhù tā de bíjiān . mǐlā xiào dé sōng le shǒu , bāo xiǎnxiē cóng dèng shàng gǔnxiàqù , tǎ wéi gǎnjǐn yòng xīgài dǐngzhù .
pairs.english: Dema held the wolf before his face, its mouth just big enough to bite his nose tip. Mira laughed and let go; the bag almost rolled off the stool, and Tavi quickly braced it with his knee.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛将狼举到他脸前，它的嘴刚好能咬住他的鼻尖。米拉笑得松了手，包险些从凳上滚下去，塔维赶紧用膝盖顶住。

pairs.target: lǎoshī zài chē biān qīngdiǎnrénshù , jiào tāmen bǎ dōngxī bān guòqù .
pairs.english: The teacher counted heads beside the cart and told them to bring their things over.
pairs.hanzi: 老师在车边清点人数，叫他们把东西搬过去。

pairs.target: tóngháng háiyǒu liǎngmíng xuéshēng , yígè bǐ tǎ wéi gāo bàntóu , zhèng wānyāo tīng gǎnchē rén shuō zuò xià nǎ zhī xiāngzǐ bùnéng yā . lìng yígè bào zhe chángchángde cè gān , gān tóutào zhe bù , zǒu liǎngbù jiù dé huítóu kànkàn yǒuméiyǒu pèngdào rén .
pairs.english: Two other students were going: one half a head taller than Tavi bent to hear the driver explain which crate under the seat must not be crushed. The other carried a long survey rod with cloth over its tip, looking back every few steps to check he had not hit anyone.
pairs.hanzi: 同行还有两名学生，一个比塔维高半头，正弯腰听赶车人说座下哪只箱子不能压。另一个抱着长长的测杆，杆头套着布，走两步就得回头看看有没有碰到人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tì dé mǎ tíbāo . bāo dài lè jìn zhǎngxīn , tā cái zhīdào tā zuótiān shuō yǐjīng zhuāng hǎo , shěngdiào le duōshǎo huà .
pairs.english: Tavi carried Dema’s bag. As the strap bit into his palm, he realized how much she had left unsaid by saying yesterday that she was packed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维替德玛提包。包带勒进掌心，他才知道她昨天说已经装好，省掉了多少话。

pairs.target: lǐmiàn yǒu huànxǐ yīshang , tān píng de tú , xiě mǎn yāoqiú de běnzi , háiyǒu biérén jiàn búdào de nàxiē xiǎngleyòuxiǎng , ná qǐ yòu fàngxià de dōngxī .
pairs.english: Inside were changes of clothes, flattened drawings, a notebook full of requirements, and unseen things she had thought over and over, picked up and put down again.
pairs.hanzi: 里面有换洗衣裳、摊平的图、写满要求的本子，还有别人见不到的那些想了又想、拿起又放下的东西。

pairs.target: chēlún páng fàng zhe yìshuāng dài ní de jiù xuē , jiǎn lǎoshī zhèngzài huànxié . tā zuòzài héngmù shàng , jiǎogēn zěnme yě dēng bú jìnqù , dé mǎ tì tā fú le yíxià chē lán .
pairs.english: Muddy old boots lay beside the wheel; Instructor Jian was changing shoes. Sitting on a crossbar, he could not push his heel in, so Dema steadied the cart rail for him.
pairs.hanzi: 车轮旁放着一双带泥的旧靴，简老师正在换鞋。他坐在横木上，脚跟怎么也蹬不进去，德玛替他扶了一下车栏。

alignment.english: could not push his heel in

pairs.target: tā dào le xiè , wèn tā shìbushì tóuyìhuí gēn duì zhù chūqù . tā shuō shì , wèn lǎoshī dāngnián dài le shénme . " dài duō le . " tā shuō , " hòulái yílù zhǎo rén fēn . "
pairs.english: He thanked her and asked if this was her first stay away with a team. She said yes and asked what he had taken on his first trip. “Too much,” he said. “I spent the journey giving it away.”
pairs.hanzi:
他道了谢，问她是不是头一回跟队住出去。她说是，问老师当年带了什么。
“带多了。”他说，“后来一路找人分。”

pairs.target: dé mǎ huítóu kàn yīwén . yīwén lìjí jǔqǐ shuāngshǒu , shuō zìjǐ shénme yě méi shuō .
pairs.english: Dema looked back at Iven, who immediately raised both hands and said he had said nothing.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛回头看伊文。伊文立即举起双手，说自己什么也没说。

pairs.target: bāo bān shàngchē hòu , dé mǎ méiyǒu mǎshàng zuò jìnqù . tā zhàn zài lún biān , xiān xiàng mǐlā yào gōngfáng de shōuxìn míng , shuō yàoshi túzhǐ yǒu shénme xīn jiéguǒ , kěyǐ xiěgěi tā , bié děng huílái cái zhī shèng yíjù yǐjīng zuò wán .
pairs.english: After the bag was loaded, Dema did not sit down at once. Standing by the wheel, she asked Mira for the works’ receiving name and wanted letters about new results, rather than returning to hear only that it was all finished.
pairs.hanzi: 包搬上车后，德玛没有马上坐进去。她站在轮边，先向米拉要工房的收信名，说要是图纸有什么新结果，可以写给她，别等回来才只剩一句已经做完。

pairs.target: mǐlā dāying le , yòu shuō bié wèile huíxìn dānwù tā zìjǐ liáng shān .
pairs.english: Mira agreed, adding that answering letters should not delay Dema’s own mountain measurements.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉答应了，又说别为了回信耽误她自己量山。

pairs.target: yīwén jiāng zhǐjuàn dìguòqù , shì chāo hǎo de jǐshǒugē , liú zhe kòngbái ràng tā jì cèzhàn de rén zěnme chàng . dé mǎ shuō zìjǐ bù yídìng néng wèn dào , tā shuō néng tīngjiàn guō zěnme xiǎng yě xíng , búbì shénme dōu chàng .
pairs.english: Iven handed over the roll: copied songs, with blank space for the station people’s versions. Dema said she might not find any; he said hearing how the pots sounded would do too, not everything had to sing.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文将纸卷递过去，是抄好的几首歌，留着空白让她记测站的人怎么唱。德玛说自己不一定能问到，他说能听见锅怎么响也行，不必什么都唱。

pairs.target: lún dào tǎ wéi , tā kàn le kàn tā de bāo , wèn zuótiān nà fēngxìn shìbushì hǎoxiāoxī .
pairs.english: Turning to Tavi, she glanced at his bag and asked if yesterday’s letter was good news.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到塔维，她看了看他的包，问昨天那封信是不是好消息。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu bǎ jiù xìn ná chūlái , zhī shuō lǐmiàn yǒu gè nǚrén dāngnián xiěxià de jǐjùhuà , zìjǐ míngtiān yào dàihuíjiā gěi sè lā kàn . tā diǎntóu , děng le yíhuìer , wèn nà jīntiān néng bunéng jiè tā yìdiǎn hǎoxiāoxī .
pairs.english: He did not take out the old letter, only said it held a woman’s words from long ago, which he would take home to show Sela tomorrow. She nodded, waited a moment, then asked whether she could borrow a little good news from him today.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有把旧信拿出来，只说里面有个女人当年写下的几句话，自己明天要带回家给瑟拉看。她点头，等了一会儿，问那今天能不能借他一点好消息。

pairs.target: " nǐ yào zǒu le , hái búgòu ? " " gěi nǐ shuō dé xiàng gǎn wǒ . "
pairs.english: “Is your leaving not enough?” “You make it sound like you are sending me away.”
pairs.hanzi:
“你要走了，还不够？”
“给你说得像赶我。”

pairs.target: tā liánmáng jiěshì , tā xiān xiào le , shuō zìjǐ díquè gāoxìng , jiùshì yì xiǎngdào dào le nàlǐ shuí yě bú rènshi , yòu méi nàme gǎn xiào .
pairs.english: He hurried to explain, but she laughed first. She was happy, she said, yet thinking of arriving among strangers made her less brave about laughing.
pairs.hanzi: 他连忙解释，她先笑了，说自己的确高兴，就是一想到到了那里谁也不认识，又没那么敢笑。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ tóu yìtiān jìn bái jiē , lián qù nǎér lǐng fàn dōu bùgǎn wèn .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered his first day at the White Steps, afraid even to ask where to get food.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起自己头一天进白阶，连去哪儿领饭都不敢问。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu zhào nà shíhòu xiǎng tīng de yàngzi bǎozhèng rénrén dōu hǎo , zhī wèn tā dào le néng bunéng shāo gè huà , gàosù tāmen shuìjiào de wū yǒuméiyǒu fēng .
pairs.english: He did not promise everyone would be kind, as he had wanted to hear then; he only asked her to send word after arriving, telling them whether the sleeping room was draughty.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有照那时候想听的样子保证人人都好，只问她到了能不能捎个话，告诉他们睡觉的屋有没有风。

pairs.target: " yǒu fēng nǐ lái dǔ ? " " wǒ ràng pà wò jì láng qù . "
pairs.english: “If it is draughty, will you come plug it?” “I will have Pavo post a wolf.”
pairs.hanzi:
“有风你来堵？”
“我让帕沃寄狼去。”

pairs.target: dé mǎ jiāng nà zhī bù láng sāi dào yīdài lǐ , zhī lù liǎngzhī ěrduo , shuō yǐjīng yǒu yìzhī le , bùxǔ zài suàn yùnfèi .
pairs.english: Dema stuffed the cloth wolf in her pocket with only its ears showing, saying she already had one and they must not charge more freight.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛将那只布狼塞到衣袋里，只露两只耳朵，说已经有一只了，不许再算运费。

pairs.target: gǎnchē rén cuī zuìhòu yíbiàn . tā cǎi shàng tàbǎn , zuò dào kào wài de wèizhì , bāo héng fàngzài jiǎo qián , shuǐbēi jiá jìn shéng lǐ , zhènghǎo kǎ wěn .
pairs.english: The driver called a final time. She stepped onto the footboard and sat on the outside, her bag across her feet, the cup fitting snugly into its cords.
pairs.hanzi: 赶车人催最后一遍。她踩上踏板，坐到靠外的位置，包横放在脚前，水杯夹进绳里，正好卡稳。

pairs.target: chē dòng shí , cè gān de bùtóu cóng tā jiān hòu tànchūlái , xiàng duōcháng le yìzhī bènzhuō de shǒu . tā jǔshǒu dàobié , xiǎnxiē pèngdào tā , gǎnjǐn dītóu . tǎ wéi tāmen yìzhí xiào dào chē guǎiguò yuànmén .
pairs.english: As the cart moved, the cloth-tipped rod poked above her shoulder like an extra clumsy hand. She waved goodbye, nearly hit it and ducked. Tavi and the others laughed until the cart turned through the gate.
pairs.hanzi:
车动时，测杆的布头从她肩后探出来，像多长了一只笨拙的手。
她举手道别，险些碰到它，赶紧低头。塔维他们一直笑到车拐过院门。

pairs.target: chē zǒu hòu , chēpéng xiǎnde kōng le bùshǎo . dìshàng luò zhe yìxiǎo jié jiǎnduàn de shéng tóu , mǐlā wānyāo jiǎnqǐ , rào zài zhǐ jiān .
pairs.english: After the cart left, the shed felt much emptier. A short cut end of cord lay on the ground; Mira bent to pick it up and wound it around her fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 车走后，车棚显得空了不少。地上落着一小截剪断的绳头，米拉弯腰捡起，绕在指间。

pairs.target: pà wò shuō xiànzài gāi chīfàn , sòng rén de rén zǒng bùnéng è dé bǐ chūmén de rén hái zǎo .
pairs.english: Pavo said it was time to eat; those seeing people off should not go hungry before the travellers did.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃说现在该吃饭，送人的人总不能饿得比出门的人还早。

pairs.target: tāmen yán táijiē wǎng fàntīng zǒu . tǎ wéi huítóu kàn le yícì , ménwài yǐjīng méiyǒu chē , zhī shèng yípiàn jiànjiàn liàng qǐlái de tiān .
pairs.english: They went along the steps toward the dining hall. Tavi looked back once; the cart was gone, leaving only a gradually brightening sky beyond the gate.
pairs.hanzi: 他们沿台阶往饭厅走。塔维回头看了一次，门外已经没有车，只剩一片渐渐亮起来的天。
